title: NASA STS-41 Intraocular Pressure (IOP) Assessment in Microgravity
author: NASA
caption: NASA STS-41 crewmember performing intraocular pressure (IOP) testing in microgravity, illustrating spaceflight cephalic fluid shift assessment relevant to Space Adaptation Syndrome headaches.
alt_text: Astronaut in microgravity undergoing intraocular pressure measurement during STS-41.
clinical_relevance: Cephalad fluid shift in microgravity is the primary hypothesized mechanism for Space Adaptation Headache and Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS) (CLIFF-041, p.1, p.5).
